Player Guide

This guide contains the same articles and quick answers as the in-game Player Guide. Press B in game, or open the Character Sheet with C and choose Guide. Browse the topics below or search the wiki for a topic, combat style, or question.

Combat Styles

  • Armor Combat Styles — Armor
    Choose Armor perks for enemy control, defensive options, or weapon use.
  • Beast Mastery Combat Styles — Beast Mastery
    Choose Beast combat perks to shape your active beast's commands, attacks, and defenses.
  • Devices Combat Styles — Devices
    Choose device perks for explosives, deployed fields, automated beacons, or ally support.
  • Espionage Combat Styles — Espionage
    Choose between evasive repositioning and delayed traps in the Espionage combat trees.
  • First Aid Combat Styles — First Aid
    Choose First Aid perks to heal allies, clear conditions, or prepare with combat consumables.
  • Force Combat Styles — Force
    Choose Force powers for hostile control, healing, protection, or movement to an ally.
  • Heavy Vibroblade Combat Styles — Heavy Vibroblade
    Choose Heavy Vibroblade for self-recovery through attacks or for defense and control that draw enemy attention.
  • Katar Combat Styles — Katar
    Choose Katar for Guard-based counterattacks and ally protection, or for attacks that hinder a target.
  • Leadership Combat Styles — Leadership
    Choose Leadership perks to bolster allies or improve nearby party attacks.
  • Lightsaber Combat Styles — Lightsaber
    Choose Lightsaber for strikes that weaken enemy defenses or for wards that protect an ally.
  • Mimicry Combat Styles — Mimicry
    Mimicry gives you combat actions learned from creatures you have analyzed.
  • Pistol Combat Styles — Pistol
    Choose Pistol for shots that reward changing targets or disrupt opponents.
  • Rifle Combat Styles — Rifle
    Choose Rifle for shots that reward careful timing or suppress enemy evasion and movement.
  • Saberstaff Combat Styles — Saberstaff
    Choose Saberstaff for attacks with resource or defensive benefits, or for repeated strikes against nearby enemies.
  • Spear Combat Styles — Spear
    Choose Spear for attacks that interrupt or burden a target, or for evasion and positional bonuses.
  • Staff Combat Styles — Staff
    Choose Staff for extra pressure on controlled targets or for attacks that disorient and knock down.
  • Throwing Combat Styles — Throwing
    Choose Throwing for hindering attacks or explosive area damage.
  • Twin Blade Combat Styles — Twin Blade
    Choose Twin Blade for repeated attacks that build momentum or spread bleeding.
  • Vibroblade Combat Styles — Vibroblade
    Choose Vibroblade for attacks that scale with defense and draw enemy attention, or for nearby area damage.
  • Vibroknife Combat Styles — Vibroknife
    Choose Vibroknife for attacks that exploit Exposed targets or extend Venom and Infection.
